description: This is a seed script for a Node.js project that initializes the database with sample data including users, events, registrations, and messages. It uses Mongoose ORM for MongoDB and contains idempotent operations to prevent duplicates during multiple runs.

methods.name: log(level, msg, meta)
methods.description: Logs messages at specified levels based on the current LOG_LEVEL setting.

methods.name: connect()
methods.description: Connects to MongoDB using the provided URI with options for autoIndex and pool size.

methods.name: disconnect()
methods.description: Disconnects from MongoDB and logs the status.

methods.name: upsertUser({ name, email, passwordHash, avatarUrl, role = 'user' })
methods.description: Upserts a user document based on email and returns the document.

methods.name: upsertEvent({ title, description, location, type, date, imageUrl, tags, organizer })
methods.description: Upserts an event document based on title and organizer, assuming titles are unique in the demo.

methods.name: upsertRegistration({ event, user, status = 'going', notes = '' })
methods.description: Upserts a registration document based on event and user.

methods.name: insertMessageOnce({ roomId, event, user, text })
methods.description: Inserts a message string idempotently, checking for existing messages within the last 24 hours to avoid duplicates.

methods.name: seed()
methods.description: Main function that creates sample users, events, registrations, and messages for local development.

ctags.name: insertMessageOnce
ctags.pattern: /^async function insertMessageOnce({ roomId, event, user, text }) {$/

ctags.name: upsertEvent
ctags.pattern: /^async function upsertEvent({ title, description, location, type, date, imageUrl, tags, organizer/
ctags.signature: ({ title, description, location, type, date, imageUrl, tags, organizer })

ctags.name: upsertRegistration
ctags.pattern: /^async function upsertRegistration({ event, user, status = 'going', notes = '' }) {$/

ctags.name: upsertUser
ctags.pattern: /^async function upsertUser({ name, email, passwordHash, avatarUrl, role = 'user' }) {$/
